searchText: is anyone here participating in the eth writers cohort? If so, have you been able to gain access to the writers-cohort channel? the email link they sent seems to take me to a non-existent channel It works for me, but if you go to the Discord of Ethereum.org, you'll find the channel for the writer's cohort right away. Are you all going to do the hackathon? I'm not sure about it since we have the EPF day on the 17th but I was curious what you all think since I've never done one. I'm going to do the hackathon :D even i want to do it! I asked the staff, and they said it's alright to sign in on the 18th. So, I think as long as you tell your team members that you might be busy on the 17th and they are okay with it, then it's fine. Also, I am looking to join a team these days👀 .
